# Episodic — Session 2026-07-12 Debugging

## Symptom

Hybrid search returned the right file but the agent still answered incorrectly because the expanded full file drowned the matched sentence.

## Root Cause

Stage 4 expansion replaced chunk_text with the entire source document. Cross-encoder ranked the right chunk; expansion threw away the precision.

## Fix Direction

Keep matched_chunk, expand only to previous and next chunks from the same section, and enforce max_tokens_returned so context-gate can pass its remaining window size.
